fieldDeltas.beforeProposedText: A stopped motor with no pending alarm schedules the ordinary startup callback at current clock plus 32000; retain an existing alarm as VICE does. FORWARD/REWIND commands schedule their 1000-cycle alarm independently of motor-running state, including motor-on before and after that alarm dispatch. Compare ordered scheduled and actual events, not a pulse-duration getter.
fieldDeltas.appendText: Also cover START while the motor is already running, with absent, read-only and writable media, with no pending alarm and with an existing pending alarm. The command reaches the start helper after resetting the gap: install t+32000 only when no alarm is pending, otherwise preserve the existing alarm; match attached-image seek, current-clock write-clock seeding and write-bit zeroing, including clock zero. Contrast START with running-motor FORWARD/REWIND, whose earlier t+1000 alarm survives the helper, and preserve any stop deadline that the command does not clear.
fieldDeltas.afterProposedText: A stopped motor with no pending alarm schedules the ordinary startup callback at current clock plus 32000; retain an existing alarm as VICE does. FORWARD/REWIND commands schedule their 1000-cycle alarm independently of motor-running state, including motor-on before and after that alarm dispatch. Compare ordered scheduled and actual events, not a pulse-duration getter. Also cover START while the motor is already running, with absent, read-only and writable media, with no pending alarm and with an existing pending alarm. The command reaches the start helper after resetting the gap: install t+32000 only when no alarm is pending, otherwise preserve the existing alarm; match attached-image seek, current-clock write-clock seeding and write-bit zeroing, including clock zero. Contrast START with running-motor FORWARD/REWIND, whose earlier t+1000 alarm survives the helper, and preserve any stop deadline that the command does not clear.

fieldDeltas.beforeProposedText: Assert stopped-motor ordinary startup at t+32000 with no pending alarm and preservation of an existing pending alarm. Observe callback dispatch separately from scheduled time; no first-Tick bypass.
fieldDeltas.appendText: Exercise the separate command-entry path: START on an already-running motor invokes the start helper with and without media, schedules t+32000 only without a pending alarm, and preserves a pending alarm while still performing the native seek and write-state initialization. Distinguish command START from motor-line re-enable, and preserve the t+1000 alarm already installed by FORWARD/REWIND before their helper call.
fieldDeltas.afterProposedText: Assert stopped-motor ordinary startup at t+32000 with no pending alarm and preservation of an existing pending alarm. Observe callback dispatch separately from scheduled time; no first-Tick bypass. Exercise the separate command-entry path: START on an already-running motor invokes the start helper with and without media, schedules t+32000 only without a pending alarm, and preserves a pending alarm while still performing the native seek and write-state initialization. Distinguish command START from motor-line re-enable, and preserve the t+1000 alarm already installed by FORWARD/REWIND before their helper call.

fieldDeltas.beforeProposedText: Startup_NoPendingAlarm_DeadlineBoundaries and Startup_PendingAlarm_NotOverwritten assert ordered schedules, callback times and events; incorrect early/late/missing/duplicated/reordered events are rejected within a passing mock harness.
fieldDeltas.appendText: Start_CommandWhileMotorRunning_NoPendingAlarm and Start_CommandWhileMotorRunning_PendingAlarm cover absent/read-only/writable media, clock zero/nonzero, seek/no-seek, retained write state and a pending stop deadline; reject omission of the command helper path, wrong alarm replacement or absence, wrong seek, wrong write-clock/bit seeding, and clearing a stop deadline that START leaves intact.
fieldDeltas.afterProposedText: Startup_NoPendingAlarm_DeadlineBoundaries and Startup_PendingAlarm_NotOverwritten assert ordered schedules, callback times and events; incorrect early/late/missing/duplicated/reordered events are rejected within a passing mock harness. Start_CommandWhileMotorRunning_NoPendingAlarm and Start_CommandWhileMotorRunning_PendingAlarm cover absent/read-only/writable media, clock zero/nonzero, seek/no-seek, retained write state and a pending stop deadline; reject omission of the command helper path, wrong alarm replacement or absence, wrong seek, wrong write-clock/bit seeding, and clearing a stop deadline that START leaves intact.

fieldDeltas.beforeProposedText: Motor-off on a running motor sets a stop deadline of current clock plus 32000 without immediate stopping or replacing an already pending alarm. Actual stopping occurs when a datasette callback observes the deadline reached. Cover callbacks before, at and beyond the deadline, active read rescheduling, STOP with a retained later alarm, repeated off preserving the deadline, and motor-on cancellation even after the deadline but before stop execution. A stopped motor starts again through the native pending-alarm rule.
fieldDeltas.appendText: Explicitly include motor-on before the stop deadline and at the deadline before callback dispatch, preserving the already-running motor, pending alarm and write state while clearing the stop deadline; neither case starts a new ramp.
fieldDeltas.afterProposedText: Motor-off on a running motor sets a stop deadline of current clock plus 32000 without immediate stopping or replacing an already pending alarm. Actual stopping occurs when a datasette callback observes the deadline reached. Cover callbacks before, at and beyond the deadline, active read rescheduling, STOP with a retained later alarm, repeated off preserving the deadline, and motor-on cancellation even after the deadline but before stop execution. A stopped motor starts again through the native pending-alarm rule. Explicitly include motor-on before the stop deadline and at the deadline before callback dispatch, preserving the already-running motor, pending alarm and write state while clearing the stop deadline; neither case starts a new ramp.

fieldDeltas.beforeProposedText: Assert motor-on cancels a stop not yet executed, including after the nominal deadline but before a late callback, without imposing a new startup delay on an already-running motor. After an executed stop, obey the ordinary start helper and its pending-alarm preservation.
fieldDeltas.appendText: Include cancellation before the deadline and same-clock cancellation before callback dispatch as separate cases from cancellation after the deadline; for an already-running motor, preserve the existing alarm and write state and clear only the stop deadline in this path.
fieldDeltas.afterProposedText: Assert motor-on cancels a stop not yet executed, including after the nominal deadline but before a late callback, without imposing a new startup delay on an already-running motor. After an executed stop, obey the ordinary start helper and its pending-alarm preservation. Include cancellation before the deadline and same-clock cancellation before callback dispatch as separate cases from cancellation after the deadline; for an already-running motor, preserve the existing alarm and write state and clear only the stop deadline in this path.

fieldDeltas.beforeProposedText: Run all named delayed-stop and cancellation cases in the amendment ledger, retaining deadline and callback boundaries separately. Reject immediate stop, guaranteed-deadline stop despite an existing late alarm, repeated-off deadline extension and unconditional off/on restart.
fieldDeltas.appendText: MotorOn_CancelsPendingStop covers deadline-1 and the exact deadline with motor-on ordered before callback dispatch; assert stop-clock clearing, unchanged running/alarm/write state and no startup ramp, and reject wrong mocks that restart only in these earlier cancellation cases.
fieldDeltas.afterProposedText: Run all named delayed-stop and cancellation cases in the amendment ledger, retaining deadline and callback boundaries separately. Reject immediate stop, guaranteed-deadline stop despite an existing late alarm, repeated-off deadline extension and unconditional off/on restart.
